Athletic Build.description:
💪 Build: Athletic Build
Well-proportioned and clearly active — balanced muscle development, good posture, and a frame that suggests regular physical training without extreme specialization.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Athletic Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Athletic frame — balanced muscle development across shoulders, torso, and legs. Fit and capable proportions, body carries visible physical readiness. Female: shoulders defined but sitting close to the hip line, slim neck, soft jaw and rounded chin, the chest line sitting above a waist drawn in. Male: shoulders clearly wider than the hips, thicker neck, square jaw, a flat chest line running straight to the waist. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own frame at this level of fitness.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
